@{60ee1be1993fb84a4b8deeb9|full_name}: you can currently disable locomotion natively when in FBT on VRC

Content creator specific suggestions:
• Camera Animation mod should be implemented too. Us content creators need it to move camera in 3D space smoothly.
• Local Light Mod - sometimes world is too dark or we want specific lighting depending on the purpose of the video. Would be better if we can animate the movement of the Lighting too!
• Change smoothness of the camera. The default smoothing option isn't enough in some scenarios, so having a customizable smooth value would be great to get the perfect motion smoothing.
• Focal Length Indicator - this would be great to match in-game camera with real world cameras so we can create mixed reality content easily and more accurately.
• Deeper zoom - The default max zoom isn't enough for me. I sometimes like to zoom in to my friends who are really far away from my location and get a clear picture of them.
• Fisheye mode - for a more creative look. This extremely wide angle fisheye look could help to create a hyper realistic look depending on the purpose of the shots. Also it's fun to play with!
• Aspect ratio changer - sometimes I want to film videos in 4:3 or ultra wide ratio so it would be great if the camera changes its shape according to the aspect ratio chosen.
• Grid - helps in composition.
And much more that I can't think of, but I hope VRChat team understands that content creators need these to create creative content

details:
Hi! There are a selection of many requests that I've seen on discord, canny, and from me and my friends.

> The most important things, that we need as soon as possible:
• Instance History (and a icon on the worlds instances to know what instances you visited recently)
• Avatar History (some times we change our avatars and forget to save the previous one)
• Avatar Search (for public avatars, with a option to creators that don't want to appear on search)
• Instance Join/Leave notifications
• Component disable (disable pickups/chairs/triggers/etc)
• Restart Button (closes and re-open the VRC automatically)
• A option to re-scale your avatar in-game (with a height limit ofc)
• Discord Mute (a integration to mute yourself in discord, many people play VRC and join a Voice Chat on Discord at the same time)
• Skip Perform Stats (a option to skip the perfomance stats of avatars, since this cause some lag spikes when a avatar loads)
• Player Pickup (grab other players by head, leash, hands, hips)
• Third Person on Desktop
• A build-in FSR/NIS/CAS solution (probably the most important here, this helps boosting my frames)
↳ https://github.com/fholger/vrperfkit
• Screenshot Manager (view, edit, delete and share your screenshots directly in-game)
• Exit Fix (for some reason, sometimes the game takes some ages to close and we need to close using task manager)
• Menu Clock (a little clock on menu, we need to know what time is it)
• Mirror Resolution (scale up or down the mirror resolution)
• Save Menu Wings (save the state of the menu wings when you close your game or menu)
• Graphics Settings (be able to change shadow settings, lighting settings and other graphics options in-game)
• Immobilize Button (most avatars don't have GoGo locomotion or a good locomotion, and we need a button to freeze our position)
• Proccess Priority (option to change VRC proccess priority)
• CPU Core Limitter
• Pre-load Worlds
• Automatic CC for deaf people
↳ Also, maybe a automatic translator (this will help to communicate with other langs)
• Manage user components (hide shader, physbone, and other components)
• Personal Pen/Personal Keyboard/TTS for deaf/mute people
• COLORS! Option to change the colors of menu, loading screen, nameplate, etc
• Photosensitivity world tag (a tag that creators have to use if the world contains rapid flashing and such. If the world have this tag, a warning should appear before enter with a option to always ignore for who is not affected)
• Remember me (sometimes we got logged out and is kinda hard to type your login when you are in a VR headset)
• Hide Avatars by VRAM usage

> And some other cool ideas: 
• Loading Screenshots (random picture from the VRC folder)
• New components for Dynamics (such as possibility to grab specific parts and move players around: https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-dynamics-reports-and-feedback/p/request-possibility-to-move-players-around)
• GIFs for VRC+ users
• Delete/Rename inactive accounts (many accounts are holding good usernames)
• Desktop Zoom (something like the minecraft optifine)
• Some improvements for SlimeVR (a build-in anti-drift and such)
• Desktop Camera
• Age Restriction Worlds
• Touchable buttons on VRC Camera, kinda hard to use the laser with small avatars
• Better Safety System (automatically remove componenets that exceed the limit)
• Allow World Creators to enable Fly/Teleport on their worlds
• Spotify/Music Integration (Buttons to quickly pause, play, skip a song)
• More information on friends page (last time online, friendship date, etc)
• When accepts a request-invite in a Invite-Only instance, transfer the request to the instance owner
• Instance Perform Condition (the instance owner choose a maximum avatar rank when create a instance, the default should be OFF/Very Poor, since the most part of users uses a Very Poor avatar)
• Extend the Trust System or change the Trusted User condition, since is not hard to get Trusted anymore (with 3 months, some avatars uploaded and VRC+ you become trusted user)
• Veteran Tag (not a rank, but a tag for who play the game for like 5 years like me)
• Password Instance Type (Instances that needs a password to join)

I probably forgot something, but having at least the important list will be enough
If I miss something, comment here and I'll update the post.
title: [HUGE] All features that we want
